name: Ludodactylus
sum: Toothed pterosaur with a Pteranodon-like head crest, from the Crato Formation of Brazil — named after the inaccurate toy pterosaurs it resembles.
holotype: SMNK PAL 3828 — Nova Olinda Member, Crato Formation, Ceará.
material: Skull missing part of the crest (removed before illegal sale).
exceptional: A plant leaf stuck between the lower jaws, possibly contributing to its death.
biology: No snout crest but a crest at the back of the skull; a fish-eating anhanguerian.
author: Frey et al. 2003
